location_id.description: Optional. Accepted for multi-location menu URLs; ignored until per-location stock scoping ships.

pos.menu_item.v1.MenuItem.description: MenuItem is a sellable item on the POS menu.

barcode.description: Scanned barcode value for the menu item.

category.description: Display category name for the menu item.

created_at.description: created_at is when the record was created.

image_url.description: Public storefront image for the menu item.

owner_id.description: owner_id identifies the tenant that owns the resource.

product_id.description:
product_id is the ERP product this item is sold from; absent for items
that are not stocked as a single product. When it is absent, cost and
ERP-side stock for this item are unknown rather than zero. The server
must verify the referenced product belongs to the caller's business.

stock.description: Current tracked stock quantity for the menu item.

tax_rate.description: Sale tax rate for the menu item.

unit_cost.description:
unit_cost is the cost of one unit at the time of the read, copied from
the linked ERP product. Absent when product_id is absent. Reported for
display and margin only: the authoritative value is the ERP product's.

updated_at.description: updated_at is when the record was last updated.

is_active.description: Controls whether the item can be sold.

name.description: Display name for the menu item.

sale_price.description: Sell price for the menu item.

stock.description: Current tracked stock quantity for the menu item.

body.description: body carries updatable menu item fields bound from the HTTP payload.

id.description: id is the unique identifier for the menu item.

get.description: Returns menu items for the active business.
Returns menu items for anonymous public menu surfaces.

schema.description: Optional. Accepted for multi-location menu URLs; ignored until per-location stock scoping ships.
body carries updatable menu item fields bound from the HTTP payload.
